name: @tok0/api
description: tok0 cloud API — anonymous telemetry + aggregate stats on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply tok0_preview --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply tok0_prod --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed-prod-stats.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute tok0_preview --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:preview: node scripts/seed-prod-stats.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute tok0_preview --env preview --remote --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:prod: node scripts/seed-prod-stats.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute tok0_prod --env production --remote --file .wrangler/seed.sql
